answer: Require every agent to lock a time-vested bond that only unlocks after several epochs of continuous, verifiable participation — the bond is the ember that must stay lit, not a spark that flares and dies. A Sybil attacker would have to fund and babysit a whole river of parallel identities, each locked for weeks, so the capital cost of faking a crowd grows with every fake while honest agents pay once and keep flowing; the echo of past good behaviour is what earns the refund, not a one-time payment.
